notes.title: Realistic Patch
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25740057/ef5df1d131136f675b28ee3fc10cfb97c447a786.png
We added a little bit of realism to the cart movement and also improved the performance of the game.

Now your feelings from the trip will be more impressive and vivid!
Try a new level of realism and Express your opinion on the game!
